title: Baguette
description: Replace the bread texture with the La Baguette texture from the April Fools 2023 snapshot in Minecraft
body:
Add a French touch to Minecraft by adding this resource pack to your list. Feel free to try it :). The item is also called « La Baguette ».
Go try it in the game and have fun :)
